constraints.name: FK_collection_items_curated_collections_collection_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (collection_id) REFERENCES curated_collections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: FK_collection_items_recipes_recipe_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ck_curated_collections_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('Draft'::character varying)::text, ('InReview'::character varying)::text, ('Published'::character varying)::text, ('Archived'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: ck_media_assets_dimensions
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((width IS NULL) AND (height IS NULL)) OR ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 32768) AND ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 32768)))))

constraints.name: ck_media_assets_location
constraints.definition: CHECK (((storage_key IS NOT NULL) OR (source_url IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: FK_media_review_decisions_media_review_imports_review_import_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (review_import_id) REFERENCES media_review_imports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: FK_media_review_decisions_recipes_recipe_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: ck_media_review_decisions_candidate_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((decision)::text = 'ConfirmedNoMatch'::text) AND (candidate_provider_id IS NULL)) OR (((decision)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('VisuallyAccepted'::character varying)::text, ('Rejected'::character varying)::text])) AND (candidate_provider_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((decision)::text = 'NeedsReplacement'::text)))

constraints.name: ck_media_review_decisions_decision
constraints.definition: CHECK (((decision)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('VisuallyAccepted'::character varying)::text, ('Rejected'::character varying)::text, ('ConfirmedNoMatch'::character varying)::text, ('NeedsReplacement'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: FK_place_names_places_place_id
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (place_id) REFERENCES places(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: ck_places_coordinates
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((latitude IS NULL) AND (longitude IS NULL)) OR ((latitude IS NOT NULL) AND (longitude IS NOT NULL) AND ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision)) AND ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision)))))
